actions.message: Scan complete for www.yeezys.com.mx.
Couldn’t find a clear return or refund policy on this store.
The page doesn’t clearly say where the order ships from.
Outside records: 2. Dates and scope are shown; product scores are unchanged.

results.reason: The website exhibits multiple scam indicators: (1) Unusually low prices and claims of free shipping/returns (far below market value for Yeezy/Adidas products); (2) Spoofs 'Yeezy Mexico Oficial' and Adidas branding without legal connection; (3) Psychological tactics aimed at urgency/fear of missing deals; (4) The company info and domain contact reference an individual in Germany, not a registered business in Mexico or an Adidas partner; (5) No legitimate contact details, only generic forms; (6) No clear privacy or payment gateway information; (7) SSL certificate/security issues; (8) The website's structure, business claim, and behavior all match major hallmarks of a 'Fake Online Shopping' scam.

The product prices are far below market value, there are claims of official status and free shipping/returns, no verified company information or real contact details are shown, use of official Adidas/Yeezy branding is intended to deceive. Multiple authoritative scam-checking services consistently rate yeezys.com.mx as a scam, with consumer reports of lost money and non-delivery. These points meet key scam indicators (characteristics 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 16), and external evidence strongly corroborates that this is a fraudulent shopping website.
